allowedWork: Compositor dependency attribution, ephemeral scene-plan ownership, independently measured budgets, behavior-preserving caller migrations, typed balanced-operation declarations and corpus, explicit-base logarithm semantics, one change-of-base exemplar, verification, project memory, and closeout.
disallowedWork: Ceiling increases, hidden code, visual changes to existing callers, second clocks or renderers, universal CAS operations, inferred truth from glyphs, unrelated families or product layout, and user-owned economics or unrelated documentation.
goal: Restore honestly measured native-KaTeX compositor ownership without visual change, consolidate verified both-sides operations through one governed family, and deliver one review-ready alternative-base logarithm exemplar.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and completed Theseus evidence.
stopConditions: Stop if existing semantic or visual behavior changes outside the new exemplar.
Stop if the failed compositor gate can only be cleared by raising a ceiling, hiding bytes, or weakening aggregate or bundle attribution.
Stop if the work introduces a second renderer, clock, scheduler, lifecycle, or paint vocabulary.
Stop if both-sides generalization accepts unverified algebra, erases distinct domain assumptions, or grows a central closed switch.
Stop if log-base work expands into arbitrary logarithm or CAS support.
Stop if user-owned dirty files overlap required edits.
Always stop for explicit human visual judgment at s28; s29 requires later approval.
